meta.title: Where Should the Cut-Off Sit?
meta.summary: Under a volume need and a bad-rate appetite, the PD gate is a policy point on an acceptance frontier — not the score that maximises a pure ranking metric. Home Credit sample scorecard; OOT figures frozen and labeled.

hero.title: Where Should the Cut-Off Sit?
hero.question: Where should the PD cut-off sit under a volume / risk budget?

sections.headline: The gate is a policy choice
sections.body:
This story ships as a directed film. Open /stories/where-should-the-cutoff-sit/film.

Ranking skill (Gini) is not the same as a cut-off you can ship. The operating point maximises approval subject to a bad-rate appetite among the approved.

methodology: Directed film scrubbing a seeded application PD field. Champion scorecard and OOT cut-off metrics are frozen from PowerBI/11-credit-risk gold (LightGBM + Platt). Operating policy maximises OOT approval subject to bad rate among approved ≤ 4% appetite. Cloud marks are illustrative; published figures are calculated or observed as tagged in the evidence pack.
limitations: Sample model only — not production IRB or IFRS 9. Competition history is not a live euro-area retail book. LGD 0.45 is illustrative. Mid-50s time-OOT Gini is honest for this public feature set. Budgeted appetite is an illustrative policy input.
